# langfuse_evaluation_rule (Resource)

Manage an evaluation rule in a project using project-scoped credentials. An evaluation rule decides which data is scored and by which evaluators. An enabled rule needs at least one evaluator assignment, and every assignment must map all variables of its evaluator. Import format: project_public_key:project_secret_key:evaluation_rule_id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "project_public_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

variable "project_secret_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

resource "langfuse_evaluator" "politeness" {
  project_public_key = var.project_public_key
  project_secret_key = var.project_secret_key
  name               = "politeness"
  type               = "llm_as_judge"
  prompt             = jsonencode([{ role = "user", content = "Is {{output}} polite?" }])
  output_definition  = jsonencode({ dataType = "BOOLEAN" })
}

resource "langfuse_evaluation_rule" "example" {
  project_public_key = var.project_public_key
  project_secret_key = var.project_secret_key
  name               = "chat-politeness"
  enabled            = true
  sampling           = 0.25

  # Omit to evaluate all data.
  filter = jsonencode([
    { type = "stringOptions", column = "name", operator = "any of", value = ["chat"] },
  ])

  evaluator_assignments = jsonencode([
    {
      evaluatorId     = langfuse_evaluator.politeness.id
      variableMapping = [{ variable = "output", source = "output" }]
    },
  ])
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the evaluation rule. Names are not unique within a project.
- `project_public_key` (String, Sensitive) The project public key used to authenticate API calls.
- `project_secret_key` (String, Sensitive) The project secret key used to authenticate API calls.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the rule evaluates matching data. Defaults to `true`.
- `evaluator_assignments` (String) Evaluators run by the rule as a JSON array of `{evaluatorId, variableMapping}` objects, where `variableMapping` is an array of `{variable, source, jsonPath}` objects. The array replaces all existing assignments.
- `filter` (String) Conditions that select the data to evaluate as a JSON array of filter objects, for example `{type = "stringOptions", column = "name", operator = "any of", value = ["chat"]}`. When omitted, the rule matches all data.
- `sampling` (Number) Fraction of matching data to evaluate, between 0 and 1. Defaults to `1`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the evaluation rule.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import langfuse_evaluation_rule.example "${PROJECT_PUBLIC_KEY}:${PROJECT_SECRET_KEY}:${EVALUATION_RULE_ID}"
```
